items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: He's the one that killed that fella. Buddy Ford sometime ago.

ctx.x: But where did he play Herbert Lindsay? Did he play along?

No, he played all the bands. All the bands. Every band was downtown. Played in Piron's band. Sometimes Piron didn't have the band. Or sometimes they just changed one man in the band sometimes. Just one man. He said, we come to work like tonight. He said, you're the boss. All of us show up down there, the whole band show up tonight. And the whole band turned around and go back home. They go to Union Harden and New Band right there. But I can't do that today on account of Union. But all of us turned around and go…
Yeah, I never heard talk of Buddy Ford though. I don't know who that is.
